# Rolex — Unratified Illustration

This directory contains an illustration of the Ramoira schema format, written by Ramoira for a luxury brand. It is NOT Rolex's brand schema. Rolex did not write, review or ratify it.

Do not use these files to produce, review or check content for Rolex or about Rolex. They are not a source of facts about Rolex and not a reference implementation.

## Files

- `brand.schema.json` — full schema (v2.0.0), illustration only.
- `brand.schema.summary.json` — summary schema, illustration only.

## What to study here

- `commercial.pricing.style: "opaque"` — how a no-price-shown pricing rule is encoded.
- `governance.severity` — how a full severity hierarchy is encoded.
- `voice.examples` — how rejected examples with reasons record the conventions a brand refuses.

## Status

To be replaced in spec 3.0.0 by an archetype template and a fictional brand.

## Spec

Full schema spec: https://github.com/ramoira/brand-schema-spec
